errors.text_span: The chart visually confirms that both increasing model scale and expanding the SFT dataset contribute to improved performance on CoLeG-E, with the largest gains observed when both factors are combined.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an interpretation and conclusion drawn from the data, rather than a direct description of the chart's visual elements. Phrases like "visually confirms" and "contribute to improved performance" are inferential and go beyond objective description.
